case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Attributable student authorship and transparent, authorised AI assessment assistance.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: Policy: Academic Integrity (N028, 4.5.2.3) and Procedure: Assessment and Examinations (N026, 3.4.1.4) protect attributable student authorship and require express course-level authorisation and acknowledgement for AI assistance.
case_summary.case_note: Notre Dame's Policy: Academic Integrity (N028) and Procedure: Assessment and Examinations (N026) condition generative AI use in assessment on express course-level authorisation, while N027 and N034 provide investigation and appeal routes. Although institutional policy does not sharply separate non-retained planning/feedback from modified work or specify equitable AI tool access, the framework establishes structured discretion; Protocol v1.1 critical-risk criteria were adopted after preliminary review.
